assertionDetails: Real independent rootadmin, Alice, Bob and Charlie register and authenticate through REST and IRC PASS; Alice/Bob share secret #vault, Charlie owns independent secret #unrelated, and all three share #barrier with real ticket-authenticated event streams.

A real protected message and event reach Bob before local workerd SessionDO eviction; afterward a separate shared-channel marker reaches Bob’s still-idle IRC and event sockets before another actor changes authorization.
A forbidden Charlie channel-info mutation returns 403 and leaves the independently read channel info unchanged; live IRC and event observers receive only the explicit shared-channel barrier.

A second local hibernating eviction occurs after the transition; Alice posts a fresh protected message unconditionally, receives its event, and the unrelated Charlie socket and stream remain live via a separate marker without receiving the private message.

Post-transition denied operations are followed by another barrier and produce no extra event or IRC payload, except Bob’s expected role-denial numeric; stopped SQLite confirms the authorized message and independent Charlie channel and Alice/Charlie DM remain, and rejected content is absent.

A fresh runtime checks independent Charlie channel and DM reads and the specified persisted revocation, then legitimate reauthorization or credential recovery restores Bob’s IRC and event delivery. These are local workerd hibernation/recreation checks, not deployed Cloudflare observations.

Owner applies bob!*@*; Bob stays alive on #barrier but receives no #vault IRC/event payload and cannot read or write it, while the stopped channel_bans row persists. After restart his JOIN gets 474 until the owner removes the ban, then delivery is restored.
The fixture uses three real channel objects under one network SessionDO; no multi-session-shard topology is created.
transports: three Channel Durable Objects and one SessionDO
